faq: When is the La Vergne Christmas parade in 2026?

The City of La Vergne holds the Spirit of Christmas Parade on Saturday, December 5, 2026. The city's calendar lists it from 3 to 4 pm. Parades are free to watch, and the tree lighting follows the parade at the end of the route, so plan to stay for the lighting.
Where does the La Vergne parade go?

The city's calendar says the parade starts at City Hall and ends at Veterans Memorial Park, 115 Floyd Mayfield Drive. The city's parade page describes the reverse direction, so check the City of La Vergne calendar before you go and arrive early to pick a spot along the route.
Is there a tree lighting in La Vergne?

Yes. The city's calendar says the tree lighting follows the parade at the end of the route, and families can walk straight over after the last float passes. The city's parade page also mentions a fireworks show after the lighting, so bundle up and plan to stay into the evening.
